content:
I’m unable to deduce the SMILES notation without any structural information about the sample. Could you please provide any of the following data for the compound?

- Molecular formula (or exact mass)
- ¹H NMR data (chemical shifts, multiplicities, integration)
- ¹³C NMR data (chemical shifts)
- IR spectrum peaks
- Mass‑spectrometry data (m/z values)
- A brief description of observable functional groups (e.g., “contains an ester and an aromatic ring”)

With that information I can determine the structure and give you the correct SMILES string.
